name: Zoom
description: Text: scales from `scale` to its size (in), or from its size to `scale` (out), about the text box's centre, with an ease; fades too unless fade is false.
author: Biliup

scale.description: The size at the start of the move in (the end of the move out): below 1 zooms in, above 1 zooms out.

ease.description: How the scale moves: linear, in, out, inOut (cubic) or a spring (spring.snap, spring.settle or spring, spring.land, spring.bounce: fitted to the move's duration, may overshoot) (D192).
